measured_findings: The agent reproduced the subtraction defect (the existing test observed 9 instead of 5).
It changed subtract to use left - right and added a regression test for subtract(2, 7) == -5.
The documented command, python -m unittest discover -s tests -v, ran 3 tests and all passed.
The agent reported that only qa_math.py and tests/test_qa_math.py were modified.
operational_friction: An initial test edit had indentation damage and required repair.
A shell reset interrupted the first final-status command; the agent reran verification.
Canvas briefly disconnected during final diff display and recovered.
limitations: One synthetic case and one model profile; this does not establish broad OpenHands coding quality.
Changed-file scope is based on the agent's reported git status; the final patch was not independently reviewed.
Usage cost was not visible and is unverified.
